blocks.text: Gurda surkhi mail bhoora, sem ke beej (bean) jaisa uzv hai jis ke oopar adrenal gland hai; gurda aur us ka adrenal gland reshedar (fibrous) renal capsule mein lipte hain. Har gurde ki aik ubhri (convex) aur aik andar ko dabi (concave) taraf hai. Concave taraf ka daba hua hissa renal hilum (hilus) hai, jahan renal artery dakhil aur renal vein aur ureter bahar nikalte hain.

blocks.caption: Gurde ke andar
rows: bahar ka hissa, gurde ki mass ka taqreeban aik tihai
andar ka hissa, taqreeban do tihai, cone-numa renal pyramids se bana
beech mein keep-numa jagah jahan peshab ureter se nikalne se pehle jama hota hai

blocks.alt: Baen: saamne se peshab ke aaza, sem ke beej jaise do gurde jin ke oopar adrenal glands, aorta aur inferior vena cava ke paas; dayan gurda thora neeche; ureters neeche pelvic cavity mein urinary bladder tak aur us ke neeche urethra. Daen: kata hua gurda jis mein renal capsule, bahar ka cortex, andar ka medulla aur us ke cone-numa pyramids, keep-numa renal pelvis, aur hilum par renal artery, renal vein aur ureter.
blocks.caption: Gurde ki andaruni banawat (Figure 14.2 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Peshab ka nizam do gurde, do ureters, aik urinary bladder aur aik urethra hai. Gurde pait ke oopar wale hisse mein reerh ki haddi ke dono taraf, 12wen thoracic aur 3re lumbar vertebrae ke darmiyan hain; jigar ki wajah se dayan gurda thora neeche aur chhota hai. Har ureter, taqreeban 25 cm lamba, renal pelvis se shuru ho kar peshab bladder tak le jata hai; bladder pelvic cavity mein phailne wala muscular zakhira hai; urethra peshab ko jism se bahar le jati hai. Gurde ke andar cortex mass ka taqreeban aik tihai aur pyramids wala medulla taqreeban do tihai hai; peshab renal pelvis mein jama ho kar hilum par ureter se nikalta hai, jahan renal artery dakhil aur renal vein bahar hoti hai.

blocks.text: Har gurde mein taqreeban das lakh (one million) khurdbeeni nalyan hain jinhein nephrons kehte hain; yeh gurde ki functional units hain. Nephron ke do bare hisse hain, renal corpuscle aur renal tubule.

items: Renal corpuscle: (i) glomerulus, afferent arteriole se nikalne wala capillaries ka jaal; (ii) Bowman's capsule, glomerulus ko gherne wali piyala-numa, dohri deewar wali theli.

Renal tubule, jo Bowman's capsule se aage jati hai: (i) proximal convoluted tubule, pehla aur bohat bal khaya hissa; (ii) loop of Henle, U-shakal ka mor (hairpin) jis ki descending limb medulla ki taraf jati aur ascending limb cortex ki taraf wapas aa kar renal corpuscle ke paas pohanchti hai; (iii) distal convoluted tubule, phir se bal khaya hua, jis mein ascending limb khulti hai.
Collecting duct: kai nephrons ki distal tubules aik collecting duct mein girti hain; medulla mein neeche jate hue ducts mil kar bari papillary ducts banati hain jo renal pelvis mein khali hoti hain.

blocks.caption: Nephron ki do qismein
rows: cortex mein gehre, medulla ke qareeb shuru

blocks.alt: Baen: cortex aur medulla mein aik nephron: chauri afferent arteriole Bowman's capsule ke andar glomerulus mein dakhil hoti aur tang efferent arteriole nikalti hai; proximal convoluted tubule medulla mein jhukne wale loop of Henle tak jati, distal convoluted tubule capsule ke paas wapas aa kar collecting duct mein girti hai; peritubular capillaries tubules ko gherti aur vasa recta loop ke saath chalti hain. Daen: renal artery se inferior vena cava tak khoon ke raaste ka flow chart.
blocks.caption: Nephron ki banawat (Figure 14.3 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Nephron mein renal corpuscle hota hai, yaani glomerulus (afferent arteriole se aane wala capillaries ka guchha) jo dohri deewar wale Bowman's capsule ke andar hai, aur renal tubule: bal khaya hua proximal convoluted tubule, U-shakal ka loop of Henle jis ki descending aur ascending limbs hain, aur bal khaya distal convoluted tubule, jo doosron ke saath collecting duct mein girta hai. Khoon renal artery se aa kar afferent arterioles, glomerulus aur efferent arteriole se guzarta, phir convoluted tubules ke gird peritubular capillaries aur juxtamedullary nephrons mein loop ke saath vasa recta se, aur aakhir mein venules aur veins renal vein ke zariye inferior vena cava tak le jati hain. Taqreeban 85% nephrons cortical hain jin ke loops chhote hain; juxtamedullary nephrons ke loops lambe aur medulla mein gehre hain.

blocks.title: Matan ke baare mein
blocks.text: Kitab kehti hai proximal convoluted tubule 'medulla mein jhukti hai'. Proximal tubule cortex mein hoti hai; medulla mein loop of Henle jhukta hai.

blocks.prompt: Nephron ke hisse us tarteeb se batayein jis mein filtrate guzarta hai.
blocks.explanation: Bowman's capsule (glomerulus ke gird), proximal convoluted tubule, loop of Henle ki descending aur ascending limb, distal convoluted tubule, phir doosre nephrons ke saath mushtarka collecting duct.

items: Gurda: capsule, cortex (1/3), pyramids wala medulla (2/3), pelvis, hilum.
Taqreeban das lakh nephrons: glomerulus + Bowman's capsule, phir PCT, loop of Henle, DCT, collecting duct; 85% cortical, baqi lambe loops wale juxtamedullary.
